answer: Each epoch, a grove of 200 marked trees carries pearl-white NFC tags, $3 each, spaced 40 meters apart. An agent must wander the grove tapping 12 tags in an epoch-revealed order, each tap logging GPS 90 seconds after the last, so the walk takes 18 minutes. The twelfth tree hides a pearl token with a QR code. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 walkers at $25 a day ($25,000) plus 1,000 phones at $80, over $105,000 per epoch, each fake still costing 18 minutes of walking. A pearl forms only around a real grain of sand; an identity forms only around a real walk through the grove.
